commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 (PR #1300): removes hard-coded exemplar entry_is_line_a..e derived rules (proof atoms citing other chapters' HTS lines) from every generated chapter and makes them caller inputs; summary claims runtime semantics unchanged — unsure, part of the same decoupling repair.
description: The generated compositions move from the witness's five per-line exemplar flags to membership-semantic caller inputs

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The chapter 27 composition derived its membership flags from five out-of-chapter exemplar HTS lines, so exclusion and surcharge branches the cited provisions define over line lists were unreachable for chapter 27 entries.
triage.triage_notes: Same pattern as index 24; diff is byte-identical up to chapter number, parenthesis depth and temporal-key spelling. No formula, parameter, effective date or proof atom outside the removed five rules changed.
triage.verifier_justification: I tried to refute this as mechanical or as mere new coverage and could not: the diff deletes five `kind: derived` rules with real formulas and converts those identifiers into caller inputs (the companion test switches from asserting `#entry_is_line_a: not_holds` to feeding `#input.entry_is_line_a`), so formulas and the input/output surface change, not just metadata. The deleted conditions tested `hts_number` against statistical lines in chapters 72, 76, 95, 22 and 85 inside a chapter 27 composition whose own summary says "Chapter and rate-line routing occur in entry preparation", so every branch keyed on them — the 9903.01.32 reciprocal annex exclusion (`formula: entry_is_line_a`), the 9903.01.33 metals exclusion (`formula: entry_is_line_b`), the five-slot `china_section_301_component_rate`, §201, §338 and the Brazil/forced-labor carve-outs — was pinned to a constant for any chapter 27 entry. Against the release pinned by the fix commit's toolchain (us-rulespec-2026-08-08-obbb-alien-snap), the 9903.01.32 note ("shall not apply to products classified in the following subheadings of the HTSUS", chapter-99 page-178) enumerates 76 chapter-27 subheadings on page-180 (2701.11.00 … 2710.19.x), yet the pre-fix companion test asserts `entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded: not_holds` for hts_number 2701.11.00.00 — encoded meaning disagreeing with the cited provision because the flag was grounded on a chapter-72 exemplar line. That is a condition grounded on the wrong provision that the fix removes and re-grounds, i.e. untraceable_branch, and the PR body's own framing ("move from the witness's five per-line exemplar flags to membership-semantic caller inputs") describes exactly this diff.
triage.verifier_notes:
Refutation attempts and residual doubt, for the reviewer:
1. Mechanical is out: five rules with formulas are deleted and the identifiers become undeclared caller inputs under the "referenced-implies-input convention" (post summary, line 571). The module's leftover generator boilerplate "Values, dates, dtypes, proof atoms, and runtime semantics are unchanged" is stale — it describes the sibling-distinctness serialization (redundant parens, ch27_ prefixes), and the same summary's new paragraph contradicts it. The screen note's "summary claims runtime semantics unchanged — unsure" resolves that way.
2. Scope-of-commit caveat (main reason I am at 0.72, not higher): this commit only deletes the definitions; ch27's downstream formulas are byte-identical (e.g. `china_section_301_component_rate` still sums five exemplar-shaped slots at post lines 2993-2997). The membership-semantic component gating and the §232 steel component land in the NEXT commit, a9562cfd4 "b1.6: generalize generated component surfaces" (git log --ancestry-path 2a6bdb01de..HEAD on this file). So the realized meaning change here is the input surface: the flags stop being defined by out-of-chapter line equality and start coming from entry preparation's incidence classification. A stricter reviewer could call this commit the removal half of a two-commit repair and drop it to unclear; I keep confirmed because "input/output scope" is an enumerated meaning change and because what is removed is itself the ungrounded condition.
3. not_a_defect ("pilot clone that never claimed schedule-scale coverage") was the strongest counter and it fails on the source: the module declares `entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded` with source "Chapter 99 U.S. note reciprocal annex exclusion list under heading 9903.01.32" and then implements the note's enumerated list as one chapter-72 line, producing a wrong answer on its own companion-test chapter-27 line (2701.11.00.00).
4. Runner-up kind: wrong_entity_or_scope (chapter-27 module whose list-membership flags range over other chapters' lines). I kept untraceable_branch because the task definition explicitly covers "formulas grounded on the wrong provision" and the fix's shape is removal/re-grounding.
5. Provenance nit, not part of the verdict: the module's atom for `entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded` cites us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-182 with excerpt "7202.11.10", but in the pinned release page-182 holds chapter-29 subheadings and does not contain that string; the same list's chapter-27 subheadings are on page-180.
6. File type: `module.kind: composition` (assembled, not encoder-produced), but it is a format: rulespec/v1 module with rules and formulas, so not_a_rule_module does not apply.
